kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-provider-config
-- base/main.tf --
provider "aws" {
  alias  = "west"
  region = "us-west-2"
}

provider "aws" {
  alias  = "east"
  region = "us-east-1"
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "this" {
  provider = aws.west
}

output "account" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.this.account_id
}
-- head/main.tf --
provider "aws" {
  alias  = "west"
  region = "us-west-2"
}

provider "aws" {
  alias  = "east"
  region = "us-east-1"
}

data "aws_caller_identity" "this" {
  provider = aws.east
}

output "account" {
  value = data.aws_caller_identity.this.account_id
}
